title: Two-Payment Settlement Rate Card: Balance-Size Reductions
content:
# Two-Payment Settlement — Balance-Size Reductions

Rate card of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements for a Two-Payment Settlement offer, read from the balance due that the Placed Consumer Accounts record shows on the offer date.

**Rate rule.** Where the account's balance due on the offer date is 1500.00 dollars or more, the Two-Payment large-balance reduction of 1.5 points applies; where it is at least 400.00 dollars but under 1500.00 dollars, the Two-Payment mid-balance reduction of 0.5 points applies; a balance due under 400.00 dollars carries no balance reduction for a Two-Payment offer.

| Balance due on the offer date | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 1500.00 dollars or more | large-balance reduction, 1.5 percentage points |
| 400.00 dollars up to 1499.99 dollars | mid-balance reduction, 0.5 percentage points |
| under 400.00 dollars | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

| Balance due | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 1500.00 dollars | 1.5 points |
| 1499.99 dollars | 0.5 points |
| 400.00 dollars | 0.5 points |
| 399.99 dollars | none |

The bands do not stack: a balance of 1500.00 dollars or more carries 1.5 points, not 1.5 and 0.5.
